title: The mark-failed path frees the comment with unclaimComment(claimId), which deletes any posted=false row for the comment, not its own claim row
evidence: app/lib/youtube-bot-post.server.ts postClaimed: when markPosting answers 'failed' it calls releasePostingMark (row- and token-scoped), then unclaimComment(claimId), which is scoped to the comment only. In a rare race, between those calls another machine can see the claim gone and insert a fresh posted=false claim; unclaimComment then deletes that row too. Cost: the other machine's model call is wasted and its mark finds no claim, so nothing is posted; never a double post. Fix: delete by the claim's row id (claim.rowId). Found in the C15 follow-up (PR 1372 review)
